scope: Make retained legacy lightsaber crystal initialization consume authored crystal item metadata instead of the receiving player's removed NGE combat level while preserving static crystal tiers, tuning eligibility, and a player-independent compatibility fallback.

eraEvidence.targetEra: Publish 14.1 PRE-CU item and Jedi progression with retained expansion crystal content
findings: Core3 stores the crafting experimental creatureLevel on the crystal as itemLevel and generates crystal stats from that itemLevel.
Core3 never derives crystal itemLevel from the player who receives or tunes the crystal.
This source's retained legacy equivalent is jedi.crystal.stats.level, which saber dismantling writes immediately after createObject returns.
Current static crystal rows carry authored min/max/quality metadata and bypass legacy dynamic initialization.

diagnosis.historicalAuthority: getLevel of the creature containing the destination inventory
